feeding_claim.verbatim: Our cattle are raised on Oʻahu pasture without growth hormones.

pickup_locations: Friday pickup 4 to 6 PM at the ranch in Waianae

notes: Oahu Meats is the beef brand of Griffith Livestock Co., a ranch in Waianae on Oahu. Beef is ordered online and collected at the ranch, with a standard Friday 4 to 6 PM pickup (other times by arrangement); no shipping or delivery is offered. The page describes pasture raising and rotational grazing but does not say the cattle eat only grass, so the category is kept at pastured. The ranch also runs sheep for targeted grazing. Beef is sold as cuts and in four bundle sizes; no quarter, half, or whole shares found.
